mainEntity.name: What is the best marketing strategy for a small cleaning company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with your Google Business Profile and a review system. A cleaning company with 50 or more recent Google reviews and an optimized GBP will outrank competitors in the map pack. Add Local Services Ads once reviews are active: the Google Guaranteed badge builds the in-home trust that cleaning clients need. In 2025, 83% of consumers used Google as their primary review source. The map pack is where cleaning clients find you first.

mainEntity.name: Do HVAC companies need Google Ads or Local Services Ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both, but for different parts of the business. Local Services Ads work best for emergency and repair calls where the customer decides same-day and the pay-per-lead model fits the economics. Google Search Ads work better for replacement and installation queries, where the customer is researching over several weeks. Running one undifferentiated campaign for both mixes two incompatible bid strategies. Keep emergency and replacement as separate campaigns with separate landing pages.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take a remodeling customer to decide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically one to eight weeks from first search to requesting bids. During that window, they are reading reviews, looking at completed project photos, and comparing contractors on Google. Your marketing needs to place you on their shortlist during the research phase, not only at the moment they are ready to call. Local SEO and a strong Google Business Profile presence do the work during research. Google Search Ads catch the bid-ready searches at the end of the cycle.

mainEntity.name: Are Local Services Ads available for all service trades?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Google approves LSA by trade and by market. Cleaning, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, pest control, and several other trades qualify in most US markets. Beauty services, medical practices, and legal services have separate LSA programs with different eligibility requirements. Check Google's current eligibility list for your specific trade before launching a campaign.

mainEntity.name: What marketing channel works best for a med spa?

acceptedAnswer.text: A combination of Instagram for discovery and Google Business Profile with Search Ads for conversion. Aesthetic clients discover services visually, often through social media before they search on Google. A well-maintained GBP also appears in AI-powered local search results. High-intent Google Search Ads for terms like 'med spa near me' or 'Botox [city]' close the deal once the prospect is ready to book.
